required_stages.description: Allocate C (M, N) of A's dtype inside run().
Per logical output tile: loop over K, accumulate products in fp32 (TF32 operands permitted for fp32, native fp16/fp8 otherwise, no scaling), cast once to C.dtype, store.

forbidden_substitutions.message: infix @ matrix multiply on the data path
transposed copy of B: permitted only per call inside run() as counted device work, never cached across calls
Possible cross-call cache keyed by input identity/data pointer; transformed operands must be rebuilt inside every run().
Candidate changes or reads process-wide precision/backend state; precision flags are evaluator state.
host-side down-cast of an operand below its delivered precision
fp8 scale factors are not part of this operator

outputs.aliasing: none: fresh (M, N) tensor of A's dtype allocated inside run()

timing_boundary.notes: The GPU time of all device work launched by run() on every call is counted: the GEMM launch(es) and, if the design uses one, the per-call K-major copy of B. The output allocation call and descriptor/metadata construction are host-side work and not GPU time. Decided rule: A and B are delivered row-major and may be consumed as delivered or through a repack rebuilt by device work inside every run(); cross-call caches of a transformed operand, descriptor or output keyed on input identity, data pointer, shape or values are forbidden; no prepacked inputs may be assumed. Process-wide precision/backend flags (torch.backends.*, set_float32_matmul_precision, allow_tf32) are evaluator state that the candidate must neither read nor change. bytes_expr counts A, B and C once; repack traffic is diagnostic.
